answer: Agents bond stake and join a Semaphore membership tree using a polynomial identity commitment. Each epoch, an agent evaluates its secret-sharing polynomial at a message-derived point and proves the share. RLN binds the proof to an epoch nullifier; sending distinct messages under the same nullifier exposes two shares, allowing Shamir interpolation to recover the private key and trigger immediate collateral slashing. onyx, sonnet, and violet are illustrative labels, not protocol secrets.
